definitions.explanation: Oil pressed from the seeds of the rape plant ({菜|な}の{花|はな}). The commonest cooking oil in Japan, used for frying and tempura and sold widely as キャノーラ{油|ゆ}.

examples.japanese: {菜種油|なたねあぶら}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{揚|あ}げる→揚げる：16879_ageru⟧。
⟦{天|てん}ぷら→天ぷら：04948_tenpura⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{菜種油|なたねあぶら}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: We use rapeseed oil for tempura.

examples.japanese: ⟦{江戸|えど}{時代|じだい}→江戸時代：20431_edojidai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{菜種油|なたねあぶら}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{明|あ}かり→明かり：01681_akari⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{使|つか}われていた→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: In the Edo period rapeseed oil was used more for lamps than for cooking.

notes:
SIMILAR WORDS:
- キャノーラ{油|ゆ}: canola oil — oil from rapeseed varieties bred to be low in erucic acid; the usual supermarket label
- サラダ{油|ゆ}: salad oil — a blended, refined oil, often largely rapeseed
- ごま⟦{油|あぶら}→油：01693_abura⟧: sesame oil

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {菜種油|なたねあぶら}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{炒|いた}める→炒める：01879_itameru⟧: to stir-fry in rapeseed oil
- {菜種油|なたねあぶら}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{搾|しぼ}る→搾る：18724_shiboru⟧: to press rapeseed oil
